Book Converter

Tutorial for the production team: from a PDF to a checked delivery, in plain steps.
What it does. You give it a book's PDF. It reads the book, you check what it was unsure about, and it writes the delivery in the format the client needs (HTML, NIMAS, DAISY, JATS, BITS, DocBook or ePub), with a quality report. Everything runs on this computer; the PDF and the results never leave it.

Start the tool

  1. Open a terminal in the project folder and run .venv/bin/python -m book_app.
  2. Open http://127.0.0.1:8777 in Chrome, Edge or Firefox. (Stop with Ctrl+C in the terminal.)

The six steps

1 Upload → 2 Profile → 3 Convert → 4 Book details → 5 Review → 6 Export. The strip at the top of a book shows where you are; you can go back to any step you have reached.

Which format and profile?

FormatProfileUse it for
HTML5html_baseWeb pages: one page per chapter, a contents page, accessible (headings, alt text, page numbers).
NIMAS / DTBookdtbook_nimas_baseUS accessible textbooks (NIMAS 1.1): DTBook XML, package file, images, title/copyright PDF.
DAISY 3daisy3_baseDigital talking books (text only): DTBook, SMIL, navigation (NCX) and page list.
JATSjats_baseJournal-article XML (NISO JATS 1.4). One article, or one per chapter for a book made of articles.
BITSbits_baseBook XML (BITS 2.2): parts, chapters, index, references.
DocBook / ePubclient profile, e.g. jaypee_v4Client deliveries to the client's own rules.

The Books page

Every book you have worked on is listed here with its state. Press New book to start another one, or open a book to carry on where you stopped. Nothing is lost when you close the browser.

Step 1: Upload the PDF

Press New book. Drag the book's PDF onto the box, or press choose a file. The PDF stays on this computer. A file that is not a PDF, is damaged or has a password is refused, and the message says why.

Step 2: Choose the profile

A profile is the set of rules for one client and one output format. Profiles marked standard are ready-made for a format with no client rules: html_base (web pages), dtbook_nimas_base (NIMAS for accessible textbooks), daisy3_base (DAISY talking books), jats_base (JATS journal XML) and bits_base (BITS book XML). Client profiles such as jaypee_v4 make DocBook and ePub.

Pick the profile, then Continue

Choose one profile and press Continue. If the profile does not yet exist for your client, see "Make a profile for a new client" at the end of this guide.

Step 3: Convert

The tool reads the PDF and works out the chapters, headings, lists, tables, pictures and page numbers. Press Convert and wait: a long book can take a long time, the progress is shown, and you can close the browser and come back. If it is stopped, press Convert again: finished pages are not redone. Scanned pages need text recognition, which is not part of this version.

Step 4: Check the book details

The tool reads the title page and copyright page and fills in a draft. Check every field against the printed book. The ISBN is required and must be a real ISBN-13: it is never guessed. Authors are read from the title page where the profile asks for it, split into role, first name, surname and degrees: fix any that are wrong, or press Add an author if none was found. Publisher, publication date and rights are optional but the NIMAS, DAISY, JATS and BITS packages need them: anything left empty is listed in the QC report as "to supply". Press Confirm and continue to review.

Step 5: Review what needs a person

The tool lists everything it was not sure about, most important first. For each item you see the page picture with the spot highlighted. Typical items: a picture needs a description (alt text), a heading may not be a heading, a table looks wrong. Fix it, or press Skip. Every change is saved with your name and can be undone. Enter your name in the who box first.

Step 6: Export

Pick the profile and the format. The format list shows only what that profile supports. "Every format of this profile" makes all of them in one go. Press Export.

If the export is blocked

Pictures and equations without a description stop the export, because accessible books need them. Write the descriptions in the review. If the client agreed to deliver without them, tick Export anyway with missing picture descriptions: the override is written into the QC report.

The result: PASS, WARN or FAIL

PASS: nothing to report. WARN: usable, but read the reasons. FAIL: do not deliver. Use Download to get the delivery (a ZIP of the folder) and Download the QC report. The review list is the list of items a person still has to look at.

Reading the QC report

The report shows three checks. Schema: the file is valid against the official standard (checked offline). Format rules: links work, images have descriptions, page numbers are complete and in order, required data is present. Lossless: no word of the book was lost or added. Anything marked "to supply" is information the PDF does not contain, for example the publisher.

Check an edited delivery

If someone edited a delivery by hand, upload the ZIP here to run the same checks on it again.

Make a profile for a new client

Open Make a profile from a client spec on the Profile step. Copy the prompt, download the schema file, and paste both with the client's guideline into an AI chat (never book content). Save the YAML it returns and upload it under Upload a profile file: mistakes are shown with line and field. For NIMAS, DAISY, JATS or BITS the AI starts from the matching base profile.

If something goes wrong

ProblemWhat to do
The ISBN is refused.Check the digits against the copyright page. The last digit must match the check digit. The tool never invents an ISBN.
Export is blocked: picture descriptions missing.Write them in the review (step 5), or tick the override if the client agreed. The override is recorded.
The result says WARN.Open the QC report and read the reasons. WARN is usable; items marked must check need a person.
The result says FAIL.Do not deliver. The reason is at the top of the QC report; fix the item in the review and export again.
A required value shows "to supply".Add it in Book details (publisher, publication date, rights, ISBN) and export again.
The conversion stopped.Open the book and press Convert again: finished pages are not redone.
The profile I need is not in the list.Upload it, or make one from the client's guideline (last section of this guide).

Questions about a client's rules: ask the technical team. More detail: docs/user_guide.md, docs/formats_report.md.
